# Queensland Public Service Salary Scales
## QLD Administrative Salary Guide by Classification
### AO 6 Salary — Administrative Officer Level 6
AnAO 6 (also written as AO6 or Administrative Officer Level 6) earns **$125,488–$134,019** gross — roughly $93,000–$99,000 take-home after income tax and Medicare, plus12% employer super (~$141,000–$150,000 total package).

## Frequently Asked Questions
### What is the AO 6 salary?
An Administrative AO 6 (also written as AO6 or Administrative Officer Level 6) earns $125,488 to $134,019 per year as set by the Queensland Public Service Officers and Other Employees Award – State 2015 (reprinted 1 September 2026).
